races.title: State House, District 53
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Howard L. Penny, Jr.
cands.bio: Republican member of the NC House for District 53 (Harnett County area) since September 2020. Fourth-generation family farmer with a career in agriculture sales, retail, wholesale and manufacturing management. Previously served on the Harnett County school board and Board of Commissioners, including as chairman.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Penny was born or raised, or when he came to North Carolina. We found no documented actions or stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreign buyers, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, campaign-money pledges, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The sources list no bills he sponsored. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022, 2024 or 2026, and Ballotpedia identified no endorsements for him in 2024 or 2026. We found no news coverage of controversies or foreign ties.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: NC House member since 2020, appointed to fill David Lewis's seat. Before that he was a Harnett County commissioner (vice chairman and chairman), school board member (2014-2016), and member of the planning board, board of adjustments and tax board of equalization. His career includes farming and retail, wholesale and manufacturing management.
qual.why: Six years of legislative service and prior local elected office, including chairing a county commission, plus management experience in business. Committee chairmanships were not counted.
qual.label: Six years of legislative service and prior local elected office, including chairing a county commission, plus management experience in business. Committee chairmanships were not counted.

cands.name: Kevin G. Thurman
cands.bio: Democrat from eastern Harnett County who has run for N.C. House District 53 in 2022, 2024 and 2026. Holds a Duke political science degree (2012) and an NC Central University master's in public administration. Has worked at Research Triangle Institute and Blue Cross NC. Has held no elected office.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as recommended in the 2026 voter guide 'Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy' (Sway voting group by Tevin Davis).

cands.gaps: We found no record of him holding public office, so there are no votes or official actions to report. We could not find his job titles or dates at Research Triangle Institute and Blue Cross NC. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, development, property taxes, land ownership, immigration, policing, guns or abortion. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, and his stated priorities come from earlier surveys and his campaign site: public education, economic recovery and equal access to healthcare. Nothing documents when or whether his family came to North Carolina, since he describes himself as a native.

local.label: Roots 100: He describes himself as a native of Eastern Harnett County and says he attended Harnett County public schools from Harnett Primary to Triton High School.
